title: Workspace packages with their own Scan.toml (and one at the workspace root)
description: From 0.13.0 the workspace Scan.toml is the default for every package, and a package's own [rule] replaces the workspace [rule] as a whole. Both packages here set [rule], so the root include of ballerina:13 applies to neither. See ws-13 for packages that inherit it.

steps.name: CLI include replaces [rule]
steps.note: From 0.13.0 only ballerina:14 runs in both packages, with a warning per package that --include-rules=ballerina:14 overrides its own [rule]. Earlier versions add ballerina:14 to each package's rules (and hello_app, which excludes rules, fails with the include-and-exclude error).
